title: Walmart Shoplifter Goes Berserk On Police For Arresting Him
description:
On April 9th, 2023, officers responded to a retail theft in progress. One of the store employees informed the officers that a man was opening merchandise boxes and putting the items inside his pockets. They even caught him doing so on the CCTV camera. Once the officers were certain about the man’s appearance, they moved ahead to detain him. The officers found a few more items the man had shoplifted hidden in his clothing. The man claimed ownership of some of those items. He was taken to the office for further processing. The officer tried his best not to escalate the situation. Shortly after, dispatch advised that the male had a warrant issued on his name. The officer tried to explain the situation to the male. He attempted to reason with the suspect. The suspect asked the officer for help in locating his phone. Despite the officer's repeated requests not to do so, the suspect continued to act aggressively. He kept abusing and yelling at the officers. He was showing no signs of stopping his aggressive behavior. The male was charged with retail theft and aggravated assault on a peace officer.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam Files.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
